Interface SmeltingExtension

All Superinterfaces:
RecipeExtension
public interface SmeltingExtension extends RecipeExtension
A RecipeExtension for smelting, blast furnace, smoker and campfire recipes.

The CookingBookCategory of the generated recipes is derived from the RecipeCategory that is passed in, not from the result item: a recipe declared with RecipeCategory.FOOD lands in the food section of the recipe book, everything else in the blocks or misc section, depending on whether the result is a BlockItem. Food recipes must therefore be declared with RecipeCategory.FOOD to show up under food. The overloads without a RecipeCategory default to RecipeCategory.MISC.

As that inference is not always what is wanted, smelting and blasting have overloads that take an explicit CookingBookCategory right after the RecipeCategory. Those bypass the inference entirely. cooking and campfire have no such overloads: smoker and campfire recipes are always CookingBookCategory.FOOD in vanilla and cannot be given another category.
